about: A save in an older layout keeps its bag when the game converts it (docs/newgold/SAVE-LAYOUT.md): route29-official.sav, written before the DNA Splicers and before the Berries pocket held every Berry, is given Ultra Balls, X Attacks, Oran and Hyper Oran Berries by savedit in its own layout; continued, the game has moved the balls and the battle items past the Berries pocket's new slots, and every one of them is in the bag with the Potions.
